custom: Glossy penny loafer; slip-on opening; apron toe; low heel
highlights:
Classic penny-style vamp: A strap across the upper and an apron-shaped stitched toe give this loafer a recognisable dress-casual profile.

Glossy upper finish: The photographed sheen adds a dressier appearance to simple trousers and coordinated office outfits.

Slip-on opening: The lace-free upper and low collar offer a straightforward footwear choice for buyers building a loafer range.

Defined sole and heel: A pronounced edge and low block-style heel distinguish this shape from flat driving shoes and fashion platform loafers.

Black and Brown options: EU38-44 sizes are listed. Send colour-size quantities, packing preference and destination for a wholesale quotation.
dedup: Exact source URL/model absent. Visually compared current HR01026NC0086 driving-puck sole and HR044L795 thick fashion platform; this low block-heel/defined-edge dress loafer differs structurally. Marshall-prop photos25/26 excluded.
